title: NATS settings
description: Server identity, JetStream, and message limits of one NATS server.

serverName.title: Server name
serverName.description: The NATS server_name, always the instance name.

jetstream.title: JetStream
jetstream.description: Persist streams and key value buckets in the instance's data folder.

jetstreamMaxMemoryBytes.title: JetStream memory limit (bytes)
jetstreamMaxMemoryBytes.description: Most memory JetStream memory streams may use.

jetstreamMaxFileBytes.title: JetStream file limit (bytes)
jetstreamMaxFileBytes.description: Most disk space JetStream file streams may use in the data folder.

maxPayloadBytes.title: Largest message (bytes)
maxPayloadBytes.description: Largest message payload a client may publish.
